method: Team needs v1, box-score only. Four Factors (Oliver) + minutes-weighted rotation skill profile, star-anchored need weights, concave FitGain, QualityGain vs the displaced player. RPR here is RPR v1.1 (Nov 20, 2026): ORtg shrunk toward the league average (K = 200 possessions used) and opponent-adjusted; rpr_v1 is the old value. Availability filter: only Rotation / depth, Elite role player, Undervalued / buy-low and High-value starter tiers; top-3 RPR players on their own team excluded; target under 55% Min, under 30 MPG, under 26% usage, under 20 PPG; RPR jump over the displaced player capped at 5.0. Teams whose highest-RPR qualifying player is under RPR 5.0 are labelled no clear star in this data. No contracts or salaries: none exist in the inputs and none are invented. No lineup/tracking data: this is a box-score fit, a prior for lineup data, not a lineup prediction.
